item.title: Cambricon Joins PyTorch Foundation as Platinum Member on Governing Board
item.description: Cambricon became a PyTorch Foundation Platinum member around September 8 and joins the governing board, extending an Upstream First contribution path across seven PyTorch modules including torch.compile rather than another Day-0 product flash.

item.title: Xiaomi Open-Sources Robotics-U0 Embodied World Model and Training Stack
item.description: Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, an autoregressive embodied world foundation model with ~4B and full-scale ~38B weight lines plus train/infer tooling, claiming FlashAR+ speedups near 83x and a top WorldArena ranking for robot-centric scene, transfer and video synthesis.

item.title: EBKernel Unveils Cog-WM 1.0 Brain-Inspired Cognitive World Model
item.description: Shanghai startup EBKernel launched Cog-WM 1.0 at the Pujiang Innovation Forum, a JEPA-style latent world model that lifts map-free ObjectNav success from 78.5% to 86.89% versus BSC-Nav and tops pi0.5 on manipulation benchmarks by up to about 16%.
